metadata.title: Enable U Product Bricks
metadata.description: Implementation-facing capabilities derived from Enable U's managed integrations, OpenTunnel and Digikoppeling, Azure and Boomi delivery, Layer7 API security, GGM data management, data distribution, Peppol, e-VOI and managed services. Boundaries and ownership are modeled assumptions; product facts are grounded in the linked primary sources.
